profile.headline: Software Engineer at BEUMER Group
profile.geoLocationName: New Brunswick, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Rutgers Alum with a Bachelor of Arts in Information Technology/Informatics, minored in Critical Intelligence on a cyber security path.

Skills in various programming languages such as Python, Java, and R including use cases in Data Analytics, Statistical Analysis, and Object Oriented Programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: East Brunswick, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: In my internship with Mareana I worked with a team of talented individuals to develop a predictive model for time series anomaly detection. Our team, using various machine learning algorithms such as Random Forests, KNN and Gaussian Elimination, successfully launched a model within Flask that gave accurate predications of anomalous activity in multiple data sets. This experience taught me many data science skills and helped me learn to work with a team to create valuable insights for business results.

positions.title: Certified Personal Trainer
positions.description: As a personal trainer for LA Fitness I helped over 30 clients meet and exceed their fitness goals. This job taught me great communication skills and the ability to motivate individuals to power through adversity. Additionally, this job further developed my work ethic and was an overall rewarding experience.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
Office Assistant for the Educational Opportunity Fund Office at Rutgers New Brunswick. This job involves calling students to let them know about opportunities within the EOF program, designing flyers and graphics to advertise events, interacting with students who come to the office with questions about the program and using Excel to manage student databases. 

Doing this job has helped me improve skills in communication, client services, and Excel.

positions.title: Package Handler
positions.description: While worker for Fed Ex, I worked with a team of other package handlers to successfully unload trucks in a safe and efficient manner. This job taught me persistence and communication as well as how to work with a team to achieve a common goal.
